about: AVSU modelled as a generic product: box (back and four sides), cover frame, glazing (Medium only, so Fine shows the valves), lock, warning label, per gas a copper pipe with BS 1710 band, lever ball valve (lever in gas colour), emergency inlet and label. Per type: the box grows 130 mm per gas to the right; O2 and VAC are shared, MA4 shows in the 3- and 4-gas types, N2O in the 4-gas type. The MA4 and N2O connectors exist in every type and stay unconnected where the gas is hidden.
